response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but his resume shows minimal direct evidence of the core GenAI requirements for this role. Only his current 4-month-old role mentions AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, with no demonstrated experience in RAG architectures, vector databases, cloud-native AI system design, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI. His track record is strong for general software craftsmanship but not aligned with the applied GenAI specialization this Staff Forward Deployed Engineer position demands.
strengths: 14+ years of proven senior/staff-level engineering experience across diverse tech stacks
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No demonstrated experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, both explicitly required
No evidence of building AI systems on major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) or AI-specific data pipelines
AI/GenAI experience is limited to a few months in current role, far short of the 8+ years required for AI-driven solutions

key_factors.factor: Insufficient depth/duration of GenAI-specific work experience
Strong general engineering seniority and leadership background
